seo.title: Nursing Jobs by Specialty - Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment
seo.description: Discover permanent and direct hire nursing roles across specialties including ICU, OBS, Med-Surg, and more. Goodwill Staffing connects nurses to full-time positions across Canada.

hero.title: Explore Nursing Jobs by Specialty
hero.subtitle: From critical care to maternity, we match your expertise to permanent positions where you can truly grow. Whether you’re a seasoned RN, an experienced LPN, or a new NP—there’s a facility looking for your long-term support. We’ll help you find the right fit.

image.alt: Nurse supporting one another in a clinical setting — Goodwill Staffing

blocks.html: Match you with contracts aligned to your credentials Assist with onboarding, relocation support, and interview preparation Assist with interprovincial licensing and onboarding Secure you competitive compensation and 24/7 recruiter access

items.question: Do I need recent experience in the specialty?
items.answer: Yes. Most roles require 1–2 years of recent, relevant experience.

items.question: Can I switch specialties between contracts?
items.answer: Yes. If you meet requirements and availability exists, we’ll support that transition.

items.question: Are these jobs available nationwide?
items.answer: Yes. We help nurses find permanent roles in almost every Canadian province.

items.question: What settings are available?
items.answer: We offer hospital, LTC, community health, and remote placements.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing places nurses in permanent positions across specialties, helping you transition into roles with confidence. We support licensing, assist with relocation, and onboarding so you can focus on long-term impact.

blocks.text: Apply Now to Find a Travel Nursing Role That Fits
Let’s turn your skills into impact. Whether you're ready for your first contract or your fifteenth, we're here to support your journey. We respond to all qualified applicants within 1 business day.
